postgres-vps3.description: Postgres VPS3 MCP — direct query DB trading_commercial via SSH port-forward. Setup: `ssh -L 5432:localhost:5432 abdullah@148.230.96.201 -p 1983` lalu connect ke localhost:5432.

_notes.install_guide: Restart Claude Code setelah edit file ini supaya MCP server auto-spawn. Cek dengan /mcp slash command — daftar server akan muncul.
_notes.github_token: Buat di github.com/settings/tokens → fine-grained → grant: repo:read, pull_requests:read, issues:read, actions:read. Set di env: $env:GITHUB_TOKEN = '<token>'
_notes.postgres_setup: Sebelum claude code start, buka ssh tunnel di terminal lain: ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_raspi_ed25519 -p 1983 -L 5432:localhost:5432 abdullah@148.230.96.201 -N
_notes.filesystem_scope: MCP filesystem scope di-set ke D:\Data\Projek\trading-apifrontend — aman, tidak bisa keluar dari root project.
